approval.basis: User continued the female day editorial product breakdown and GitHub upload workflow with minimal looks.

copy.captionKo: 네이비, 그레이, 아이보리. 색보다 부드러운 표면.
copy.captionEn: Navy, grey and ivory. Texture leads.
copy.captionDe: Marineblau, Grau und Elfenbein. Die Textur gibt den Ton an.
copy.introKo: 네이비 코트 안에 아이보리 터틀넥을 넣고 그레이 머플러를 길게 떨어뜨려요. 차콜 와이드 팬츠와 어두운 삭스·로퍼로 흐름을 이어가고, 얇은 골드 톤 주얼리만 더해요.
copy.introEn: Wear an ivory turtleneck beneath navy and let a grey scarf fall long. Charcoal wide-leg trousers flow into dark socks and loafers; fine gold-tone jewellery keeps the accents small.
copy.introDe: Trage einen elfenbeinfarbenen Rollkragen unter Marineblau und lasse den grauen Schal lang fallen. Eine weite anthrazitfarbene Hose geht in dunkle Socken und Loafer über; feiner goldfarbener Schmuck setzt kleine Akzente.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 네이비 테일러드 코트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: deep navy textured wool-look tailored coat with broad notched lapels, straight relaxed body and sleeves, front dark buttons, longer lower hem concealed by seated pose conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 터틀넥의 접힌 칼라를 정돈하고 머플러를 바깥으로 둘러요. 아이보리를 목과 커프에서 보여줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Set the folded turtleneck collar neatly beneath the scarf, showing ivory at neck and cuffs.
products.descriptionDe: Ordne den umgeschlagenen Rollkragen unter dem Schal und zeige Elfenbein an Hals und Bündchen.
products.altKo: 아이보리 터틀넥 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ivory cream ribbed turtleneck knit sweater with folded high neck and ribbed long cuffs, soft close-to-body fit, hidden torso and sleeves conservative

products.descriptionKo: 목에 한 번 두르고 양 끝을 길게 늘어뜨려요. 프린지가 하의 위로 자연스럽게 이어지게 해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wrap once around the neck and let the ends fall long, with the fringe resting over the trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Lege den Schal einmal um den Hals und lasse die Enden lang über die Hose fallen.
products.altKo: 그레이 프린지 머플러 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE light-medium grey heather softly fuzzy long scarf with fine twisted fringes, plain grey, full length neatly laid

products.descriptionKo: 넉넉한 통을 접거나 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 상의 밑단을 정돈해 하의의 실루엣을 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the generous legs fall naturally and keep the top hem neat so the trouser shape stays visible.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die weiten Beine natürlich fallen und ordne das Oberteil, damit die Form der Hose sichtbar bleibt.
products.altKo: 차콜 와이드 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: charcoal dark grey fine wool-look woven wide straight-leg tailored trousers, soft subtle heather grain, concealed waist and back conservative

products.descriptionKo: 팬츠와 신발 사이에 리브 조직을 짧게 드러내요. 발목에 과하게 뭉치지 않게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Show a short section of ribbing between trousers and shoes without excessive bunching.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige zwischen Hose und Schuhen etwas Rippstruktur, ohne die Socken stark zu stauchen.
products.altKo: 차콜 리브 삭스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair dark charcoal black ribbed crew socks matching visible crossed ankle

products.descriptionKo: 와이드 하의 아래 앞코와 솔이 드러나게 밑단 길이를 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Set the trouser length so the toe and sole remain visible beneath the wide leg.
products.descriptionDe: Wähle die Hosenlänge so, dass Spitze und Sohle unter dem weiten Bein sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 블랙 페니 로퍼 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair glossy black leather-look classic penny loafers, moc toe stitching, low black heel and black soles, one reference shoe cropped so hidden pair conservative

products.descriptionKo: 작은 후프로 얼굴 가까이에 은은한 포인트를 더해요. 목걸이와 비슷한 금속 톤으로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a subtle accent near the face with small earrings, keeping the metal tone coordinated.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit kleinen Ohrringen einen dezenten Akzent am Gesicht und stimme den Metallton ab.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 슬림 후프 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair small slender gold-tone round hoop earrings as visible at ear, no other jewelry

products.descriptionKo: 얇은 링 하나로 손의 디테일을 더해요. 다른 액세서리와 골드 톤을 맞춰요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a single slim ring and coordinate its gold tone with the other accessories.
products.descriptionDe: Ergänze einen einzelnen schmalen Ring und stimme seinen Goldton auf die übrigen Accessoires ab.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 슬림 링 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE thin plain smooth gold-tone finger band from ring visible on hand holding cup, exact metal not established

products.descriptionKo: 소매 끝에 가는 골드 톤 체인 팔찌를 살짝 보여줘요. 다른 주얼리와 톤을 맞춰요.
products.descriptionEn: Reveal a fine gold-tone wrist chain at the cuff, matching the other jewellery.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige am Ärmelabschluss eine feine goldfarbene Armbandkette im Ton des übrigen Schmucks.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 체인 브레이슬릿 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE delicate fine gold-tone chain wrist bracelet with tiny linked chain as visible above cream cuff, full loop and hidden clasp conservative

products.descriptionKo: 작은 노즈 링은 다른 주얼리와 같은 골드 톤으로 맞춰요. 크기를 키우거나 장식을 더하지 않아요.
products.descriptionEn: Keep the tiny nose hoop in the same gold tone as the other jewellery, without enlarging or adding ornament.
products.descriptionDe: Halte den kleinen Nasenring im Goldton des übrigen Schmucks, ohne ihn zu vergrößern oder zu verzieren.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 미니 노즈 링 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE tiny thin plain gold-tone nostril hoop based on clearly visible small nose hoop in reference, isolated complete hoop, no face or other jewelry; hidden opening conservative

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, linings, waistbands, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite footwear are conservative reconstructions.
Jewelry backs, posts and clasps are inferred; actual metal composition is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition or performance.
Exact actual and feels-like temperature values are unknown; Chilly is grounded in the source folder.
Nose hoop, finger band and wrist chain interpreted from small visible details; hidden closures conservative. Cropped loafer pair reconstructed from the visible shoe.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, paper grocery bags and groceries are scene props, excluded from outfit products.
